title: Pacific Northwest Board
seo_title: Pacific Northwest Charcuterie Board: Salmon, Hazelnuts & Plan
description: A Pacific Northwest charcuterie board for 8–12: Tillamook aged cheddar, Beecher's Flagship, local chèvre, wild smoked salmon, crab dip, hazelnuts and marionberries.
hook: Wild salmon, hazelnuts and Northwest cheeses: a regional board for 8 to 12 that tastes like Oregon and Washington.
why: Two Northwest cheddars, Oregon's Tillamook and Seattle's Beecher's Flagship, make the cheese course, with a local chèvre for contrast. Wild smoked salmon and a smoked crab dip bring the coast.
Oregon's Willamette Valley grows almost all of America's hazelnuts, so they're here roasted and in the honey. Marionberries, Pinot Noir jam and sourdough finish the regional story.

timeline.what: Take out the cheeses; keep the salmon and crab dip cold.
Slice the apples and sourdough; fill the small bowls.
Place the cheeses and the hazelnut honey.
Add the salmon, crab dip, meats and berries.
Pour a Willamette Pinot Noir and serve.

faq.q: What foods are from the Pacific Northwest?
faq.a: Wild salmon, Dungeness crab, hazelnuts, marionberries and other berries, apples, Tillamook and Beecher's cheeses and Willamette Valley Pinot Noir.

faq.q: Can I swap the regional cheeses?
faq.a: Yes. Any aged white cheddar works for Tillamook or Beecher's, and blackberries work for marionberries.

faq.q: What wine goes with this board?
faq.a: Oregon Pinot Noir. It's light enough for salmon and has the fruit for the berries and jam.
